rentalPrice.q: How much does it cost to rent skis or a snowboard in Karpacz?
rentalPrice.a: A full set of equipment (skis or snowboard, boots and poles) at the Karpatka rental shop costs {day} per day and {night} for night skiing (17:00–21:00).

passPrice.q: How much is a ski lift pass in Karpacz?
passPrice.a: Prices start at {hourNormal} per hour ({hourReduced} reduced). A day pass (9:00–16:30) costs {dailyNormal} ({dailyReduced} reduced), and an evening pass (16:30–21:00) — {eveningNormal} ({eveningReduced} reduced). See the full price list in the Prices section.

ownGear.q: Do I need my own ski equipment?
ownGear.a: No. The rental shop is on site and provides full equipment — skis, snowboards, boots and poles — no preparation needed.

learnBasics.q: Can I learn to ski from scratch in Karpacz?
learnBasics.a: Yes. Beginners have a gentle conveyor lift and ski and snowboard instructors offering private and group lessons (55 minutes, from {lessonSolo} for 1 person, +{extra} for each additional person).

smallKids.q: Is there anything for young children who don't ski yet?
smallKids.a: Yes — the sledding hill (1h for {sled1h}, 2h for {sled2h}) and a conveyor lift for the little ones that makes the first attempts at skiing easier.

sleddingWhere.q: Where can I go sledding in Karpacz?
sleddingWhere.a: The Karpatka slope has a prepared sledding hill — we provide the equipment (sleds), a safe environment, artificial snow and lighting.

sledsIncluded.q: Are sleds included in the sledding hill ticket?
sledsIncluded.a: Yes — sleds are included in the sledding hill ticket, so there's no need to bring your own.

sleddingSnow.q: Is the sledding hill covered with artificial snow?
sleddingSnow.a: Yes, it is covered with artificial snow, so it can be used even when there is little natural snow.

sleddingTicket.q: Where can I buy a sledding hill ticket?
sleddingTicket.a: You can buy a sledding hill ticket on site at the Karpatka ticket office.

location.q: Where exactly is the Karpatka ski lift?
location.a: The Karpatka ski lifts are at ul. Myśliwska 3 in Karpacz (58-540), in the Giant Mountains, right below Śnieżka, with free parking right next to the slope.

openingHours.q: What are the current opening hours of the slope and the rental shop?
openingHours.a: Opening hours depend on snow and weather conditions, so we update them regularly — check the conditions board at the top of the page and the footer.

footer.about: Ski lifts in Karpacz — Giant Mountains. A place for skiing, snowboarding and sledding for children and adults.
